title: Duplicate `self.downsize` definition silently shadows the 4-arg version, breaking `Jobs::ResizeEmoji`
description: Method at line 149 redefines line 145, shadowing it. Ruby keeps only the last definition (arity 3..4). Caller at app/jobs/regular/resize_emoji.rb:14 passes 5 args → ArgumentError.

title: Client-side size check hardcoded to 10MB now governs attachments, not just images
description: Hardcoded 10MB replaces dynamic setting lookup, removing max_attachment_size_kb from client validation. Legitimate attachments blocked on sites with higher limits; server error differs from client message.

title: `"80%"` is not a valid geometry for the animated-GIF branch, so large animated GIFs fail all 5 attempts
description: gifsicle --resize-fit rejects percentage geometry (accepts only WxH). Fails 5 times, then Upload.create_for rejects oversized file. Non-animated path silently strips animation.

title: SVG uploads are pushed through ImageMagick, contrary to the SVG carve-out every other call site has
description: SVGs over size limit are rasterized by convert, mangling the vector while filename remains .svg. OptimizedImage.create_for and Upload.create_for handle SVGs with Nokogiri instead.
